source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 众惊追因，疑云更深
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC23 after EP02 SC22 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from Tuobaye's impossible reversal into the next dramatic aftermath: the crowd shifts from shock toward suspicion, Shisilang reels in humiliation, Keshadu probes for the hidden helper, and the white-clothed woman's invisible pressure line continues tightening.
title: 众惊追因，疑云更深

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC22 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC22 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH02 required storyboard regeneration before pass.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 拓拔野在暗助下反打十四郎，众人目瞪口呆，科沙度起疑。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 众人的情绪从震惊转向追问。十四郎既恼怒又难堪，颜面受挫。科沙度开始更明确地判断，拓拔野背后一定有人以高强内力或术法遥控相助，并将怀疑逐渐逼向白衣女子。场面表面平静下来，暗线压力却更重，为下一段更直接的盘问与心理对峙蓄势。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后重点会从武力反转过渡到身份猜疑与隐藏援手的追查，白衣女子的克制与危险感要进一步抬升。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, restrained, and dangerous; no overt spell spectacle.
Keshadu must remain colder, shrewder, and more suspicious than the surrounding crowd.
Shisilang should look humiliated and volatile after the reversal, not calmly reset.
The white dragon-deer may stay present as a protective witness, but should not dominate the suspicion beat.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: humiliation, suspicion, silent pressure, and shifting crowd attention should appear as separate visual steps.
